program.name: ENS Service Provider Program, Season 3 (SPP3) Marketplace RFP
program.authority: ENS DAO social amendment (EP7.1) authorizing the SPP3 committee to run a scoped Marketplace RFP

governingPolicy.version: one-time Marketplace RFP amendment plus published submission timeline/rubric
governingPolicy.changeSummary: One-time amendment to SPP3 authorization extending the committee mandate to run an open Marketplace RFP from uncommitted budget after EthID declined, with marketplace-specific rubric and milestone-gated award design.
governingPolicy.previousVersion: SPP3 program authorization without Marketplace RFP mandate

rules.description: EP7.1 is a published social proposal to amend SPP3 to authorize a scoped Marketplace RFP using already-authorized uncommitted funds; treated as within the public governance process.

eligibility.rationale: Unit of analysis is the RFP authorization amendment. Applicant hard-screen results for marketplace proposers are not reconstructed as settled awards.

evaluators.displayName: ENS DAO Snapshot electorate for EP7.1
evaluators.role: approve or reject the Marketplace RFP amendment
run the authorized RFP under published rubric and quorum rules after EP7.1 passage

evidence.description: EP7.1 social proposal authorizing Marketplace RFP, budget ceiling, and milestone-gated award design.

Marketplace RFP submission timeline and artifacts post stating DAO approval, publishing rubric/eligibility, and recording that applications are closed without settling a final awardee in this reconstruction.
SPP3 cohort recommendation context for EthID withdrawal and uncommitted budget.

criteria.name: DAO social vote outcome authorizing the Marketplace RFP
criteria.scoreScale: pass/fail social vote; timeline post states the DAO approved EP7.1

criteria.name: Marketplace RFP rubric M1–M5 for subsequent provider selection
criteria.scoreScale: 1-5 weighted rubric published for applicant scoring; no final winning score settled in this reconstruction

materialFindings.statement: The Marketplace RFP timeline post states the DAO approved EP7.1 by Snapshot vote and opens the RFP under that authority.

Public timeline artifacts describe submission close, committee evaluation windows, and an award-announcement target, but this reconstruction does not treat a final marketplace awardee, award amount, or interview outcome as settled.
EP7.1 and the timeline post authorize a milestone-gated award structure (build milestones through go-live and traction gates), with stream pause if go-live is missed without committee approval.

evaluation.aggregateScale: No final marketplace applicant score is settled in the reviewed public record for this reconstruction.

decision.authority: ENS DAO Snapshot social vote on EP7.1, with subsequent RFP administration by the SPP3 committee
decision.rationale: The public timeline post states the DAO approved EP7.1 authorizing the Marketplace RFP. The literal status 'authorization-passed' is outside the v0.1 closed vocabulary because mapping authorization-without-settled-awardee into approved would invent a positive awardedAmount and overstate provider-award settlement.
decision.decisionRule: Snapshot social proposal for EP7.1; committee then runs RFP under published rubric with quorum of three of four Member seats.

challenge.scope: Reviewed public EP7.1 artifacts do not identify a dedicated post-authorization correction path beyond ordinary governance.

deliveryConditions.description: Authorized design: one award of up to $500,000, roughly half streamed through go-live build milestones and half released against on-chain-verifiable traction gates; go-live miss pauses the stream without committee-approved revision.
deliveryConditions.reviewWindow: Award term co-terminating with SPP3 cohort (~11 months) once an awardee is selected and KYC/executable complete
deliveryConditions.verificationMethod: Milestone acceptance criteria and on-chain traction gates as published; exact per-award thresholds set at signing.
deliveryConditions.verifier: SPP3 committee and accountability body / ENS Foundation per published RFP terms
dependencies: Final awardee selection and public winning score (not settled in this reconstruction)
Service agreement, KYC, and executable funding vote
deliveryConditions.consequence: Amounts not released by term end return to the DAO treasury; if no proposal clears the bar, nothing is funded.

notes: Unit of analysis is EP7.1 RFP authorization plus incomplete public provider-selection process, not a named marketplace awardee.
No final awardee, award amount, or interview outcome is invented.
The literal status 'authorization-passed' is intentionally outside the v0.1 closed decision.status vocabulary.
decision.decidedAt for EP7.1 remains null at schema-v0.1 precision.
EthID withdrawal is background context and is already encoded as a separate case.
Reference-only remote sources are not represented as exact byte-preserved captures.
